== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Shawn Valdez (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Shawn Valdez]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>5bd144dfbe69db98776451f8b10f81a34cbfb181</code>.
